type Tree<T> = [T, Tree<T>[]];
const tree: Tree<number> = [1, [[2, []], [3, [[4, []]]]]];
const badLeaf: Tree<number> = [1, [[2, [[3, [["x", []]]]]]]];
type Nest<T> = Nest<T>[];
const badNest: Nest<number> = [[], [1]];
type Grow<T> = [T, Grow<T[]>[]];
const badGrow: Grow<number> = [1, [[2, []]]];
type Pair<A, B> = [A, Pair<B, A>?];
const badPair: Pair<number, string> = [1, [2]];
const strings: Tree<string> = tree;
type Spread<T> = [T, ...Spread<T[]>];
type Length<T> = Length<T>[]["length"];
type Record2<T> = Record<string, Record2<T>>;
function nest<T>(value: T) {
  type Local = [T, Local[]];
  const local: Local = [value, [[value, []]]];
  return local;
}
const wrongLeaf: string = nest(1)[1][0][0];
console.log(tree, strings, wrongLeaf);
